title: Checkout collects the setup fee and starts a trialing subscription
description:
**Phase 3 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the invitation story, in the triage epic
- **Runs in parallel with:** the webhook signature story
- **Unblocks:** the enablement story

---
One Checkout session carrying two things: the one-time setup fee, charged now, and the monthly subscription, created on a trial.

**The subscription must not begin billing at checkout.** Provisioning can take days of back-and-forth with a security team, and charging a monthly fee for an organization that does not exist yet is the kind of small unfairness beta customers remember and repeat. The trial ends at enablement, in the next story.

Terms acceptance is collected by Stripe on the session rather than implied by a checkbox on a page, so what was accepted and when is recorded somewhere that survives a page edit.

The organization is created before checkout and lands pending, which is the behavior that already exists. Checkout does not create it.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Paid enablement

  Scenario: Checkout charges setup now and defers the subscription
    Given an invited person who has signed in and named their organization
    When they complete Stripe checkout
    Then the setup fee is charged once
    And a subscription is created on a trial
    And no monthly amount has been charged

  Scenario: The organization stays pending after payment
    Given an invited person who has signed in and named their organization
    When they complete Stripe checkout
    Then the organization status is pending

  Scenario: Terms acceptance is recorded on the session
    Given an invited person at Stripe checkout
    When they complete checkout
    Then the session records their acceptance of the beta terms
